messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Famotidine oral can make it harder for your body to absorb other medicines you take by mouth. Tell your doctor if you are taking:
- cefditoren;
- dasatinib;
- delavirdine;
- fosamprenavir; or
- tizanidine.
This list is not complete. Other drugs may interact with famotidine, including prescription and over-the-counter medicines, vitamins, and herbal products. Not all possible drug interactions are listed here.
Triplet: ["Famotidine", "has potential interaction with", "vitamins"]

The relation 'has potential interaction with' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug may have an adverse or altered effect when taken concurrently with the substance specified by the object entity, which may include prescription, over-the-counter, dietary, or herbal products.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
B. 'interacts with': The subject drug has a drug interaction with the drug or substance specified by the object entity that may change effects or cause harm.
C. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
D. 'can occur with': The subject drug can be present in individuals who also have the condition specified by the object entity.
E. 'has product variation': The subject drug has a different formulation or version specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
